2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/NAIVASHA KONGONI LODGE/NAIVASHA KONGONI RESIDENT RATES 2026.pdf
validity: 2 January 2026 - 31 December 2026 (non-resident sales contract); January-December 2026 (resident rate sheet)
notes: Non-resident sheet gives three rate columns per room/meal-plan combo: Rack (public ceiling rate), Contract (Sunworld's discounted rate), Holiday (Easter/Christmas/New Year rate).
Family Cottage rate is priced for 2 adults + 2 children (3-11 years) as a package, not a standard per-person or per-room rate.
No seasonal (peak/shoulder/green) rate variation for non-resident rates beyond the 3 columns - Rack/Contract/Holiday. Resident sheet similarly has Rack/Contract/Holiday.

Booking release periods and deposit percentages vary by season (Peak: Jun/Jul/Aug & Feb; Festive: Easter/Christmas; Shoulder: Jan/Sep-mid Dec; Green: Mar/Apr/May) - these seasons govern DEPOSIT/CANCELLATION timing, not the room rate itself, which only varies by the Rack/Contract/Holiday split.

childPolicy.raw: Below 3 years: free. 3-11 years: 50% of adult rate. Extra child in Family Cottage (3-11yrs): US$47/night (non-resident) or KES4,500/night (resident). 12+ years: charged as single adult.

policies.cancellationNonResident: 29-15 days: 25% of room charges; 14-3 days: 50%; within 48 hours or no-show: 100%
policies.depositResident: 50% deposit on confirmation, balance before check-in
policies.cancellationResident: 30+ days: 0% penalty, full deposit refund; 29-15 days: 25%; 14-2 days: 50%; 1 day prior/upon arrival/during stay/no-show: 100%
policies.confidenceNote: [Unverified] Cancellation policy differs between the non-resident (percentages of 'room charges for entire stay', tighter thresholds) and resident (percentages with a 0%-penalty >30 days band) documents - not reconciled, both quoted as stated in their respective source.
